description: The agent skills of the focused project as links to one clone of a skill Catalog (bundles.yaml): a directory junction on Windows, a symbolic link on macOS and Linux. Only the clone has the skill files and version control, so a change there shows in every project at once. The panel shows linked, missing, stale and extra skills, with buttons to choose Bundles and to link, add and remove skills. A toast offers to make missing links and remove stale ones. A skill of another repository links to a clone of that repository in the cache of the mod, which you update with a button. Copies that npx skills installed become links. Catalog manages the Catalog itself: the Bundles of each skill, skills without a Bundle, new Bundles. Works in spaces on other machines too, with the clones on that machine.

settings.label: Skill Catalog
settings.hint: The GitHub repository of your default skill Catalog, as owner/name. It must have a bundles.yaml at its root. A project uses it when its skills.yaml does not name another Catalog (catalog: owner/name). Without your own clone, the mod clones it into ~/.config/herdr-app/cache/skill-bundles/ with gh (when you are logged in) or git, and links the skills of your projects to that clone.

settings.label: Your own clone of the default Catalog (optional)
settings.hint: A folder with your own clone of the default Catalog. The projects link to this folder, so they see its branch and also its changes that are not committed. The mod pulls it (git pull --ff-only) each time it fetches the Catalog, when it has no changes. When the mod cannot pull it, the panel says why and shows buttons (stash, discard, push, commit with an agent). Empty: the mod keeps a clone of its own. For a project on another machine, the mod uses this setting of the Herdr app of that machine, not of this computer.

settings.label: Your own clones of other Catalogs (optional)
settings.hint: One row for each Catalog: its name (owner/name) and the folder of your own clone of it. A project whose skills.yaml names that Catalog (catalog: owner/name) links to this folder, and the Bundle picker of a project without skills.yaml offers the Catalogs of this table. A Catalog without a row gets a clone of the mod. A row for the default Catalog wins over the setting above. For a project on another machine, the mod uses the table of the Herdr app of that machine.

settings.label: Clone URL (optional)
settings.hint: The URL for git clone of the default Catalog when gh is not logged in, or when you want another URL. Empty: git@github.com:<owner>/<name>.git. Another Catalog is always cloned with gh or from that address.

settings.label: Fetch the Catalog every
settings.hint: How often the mod fetches the Catalog and brings its clone to the remote, and fetches the clones of other repositories (it only counts their new commits). The refresh button of the panel fetches at once.

settings.label: Offer to make and remove links
settings.hint: When a project has missing skills, copies of npx skills or stale links, the mod shows a toast once. A click on the toast makes and removes the links. A new set of skills shows a new toast. The mod never changes a project without a click.

settings.label: Shortcut of the Skill Bundles panel
settings.hint: Saved in keys.json. Opens the panel as a dialog. Only the status bar item listens for this command, so the key works in a layout with the status bar item.
